_readme: Photo registry. All photos are free-to-use stock from Pexels (Pexels License: free for commercial use, attribution not required, credit kept here anyway). status 'stock' blocks the launch build until each photo is replaced with the business's own or set to 'licensed' after the license is checked. Credits: PHOTO_CREDITS.md.
